objective: Offline whole-program, horizon-aware deterministic coaching and honest independent capability evidence
preconditions: New science boundaries fail closed until independent approval

steps.change: Freeze preexisting bytes and write program/policy/interface contracts
steps.expected_outcome: 239 baseline tests pass; immutable input manifest

steps.change: Implement validated program compiler and schedulable prescriptions with tests before logic
steps.expected_outcome: RED behavior failure then GREEN hierarchy, feasibility and safety

steps.change: Implement actual-only learning and MEC program adaptation; compare feasible counterfactuals
steps.expected_outcome: deterministic stable plans, evidence-sensitive decisions, no causal overfit

steps.change: Simulate 4/8/12/16-week trajectories and scenarios A–G, regression and SSCTR binding
steps.expected_outcome: bounded trajectories/provenance, current tests; scientific gaps explicit

steps.change: Hash freeze, fresh independent sealed holdout, one first evaluation and independent quality/security-of-invariants review
steps.expected_outcome: immutable first evidence, independently judged goal quality, current hashes

steps.change: Integrate disposition, gaps, reports and separate verdicts
steps.expected_outcome: current objective evidence supports every delivery claim

risks: Whole-program assembly may exceed R4 local boundary scope
Static future dose can masquerade as adaptive coaching
Synthetic outcomes are fixtures, not physiology
Holdout contamination or retuning must not be hidden
Finite anchor repertory cannot establish general V1 optimality
stop_conditions: No stale independent gate claimed current
rollback: New modules are separate versioned entrypoints; preserve R4 commands/bytes and all first-evaluation evidence. No destructive reset or deletion.
